repository.name: MC_legends
protection_summary: Remote repository is empty; no branch exists to inspect for branch protection through the available connector.

product.vision: Provide a child-friendly Avaloria co-creation web experience while keeping the final Minecraft-versus-standalone product format reversible until Jira MCL-1 is resolved.
target_users: children around the intended project age
family/admin users for later review flows
user_problems: Children need a simple way to answer one current Avaloria question.
Users must be told truthfully whether an idea is only local or acknowledged by the project.
outcomes: Sprint 1 can persist a text submission locally and recover it after reload.
Sprint 2 can add a server acknowledgement path without rebuilding domain/UI boundaries.
user_journeys: answer current question -> store locally -> show truthful local state

business.statement: Reach a testable web increment quickly without committing the unresolved game format.

domain.statement: Original submissions remain immutable source artifacts and acknowledgement state remains explicit.

data.statement: Sprint-1 submissions require stable IDs, timestamps, question reference and browser persistence across reload.

integration.statement: Server inbox and later Supabase persistence must be addable behind an adapter seam.

security_privacy.statement: No private server/service credentials may be shipped to the browser.

reliability.statement: A locally saved submission must survive browser reload; server-arrived state may only follow acknowledgement.

performance.statement: No numeric performance SLO is established in the read backlog; avoid architecture justified by invented scale targets.

modifiability.statement: Changing persistence from IndexedDB to server/Supabase must not require domain/UI reconstruction.

operability.statement: Prefer one web deployment unit until independent operations are justified.

cost.statement: Avoid queues, caches, multiple services and infrastructure without an observed driver.

team_governance.statement: Development is performed by coding agents; deterministic tests and repository instructions are required handoff controls.

delivery.statement: Changes must be delivered through a dedicated GitHub work branch and validated PR flow.

platform.statement: The current decision covers the web platform only; Minecraft loader/platform choice remains unresolved under MCL-1.

quality_scenarios.stimulus: valid text submission is saved and the page/browser repository is recreated
quality_scenarios.response: the same submission is loadable with unchanged ID and original text
quality_scenarios.response_measure: binary pass: same ID and byte-for-byte original text after reload/repository recreation

quality_scenarios.stimulus: UI requests its status before server acknowledgement
quality_scenarios.response: local-only state is returned and server-arrived state is not returned
quality_scenarios.response_measure: binary pass: local label is exactly the Jira-defined local wording and no server-ack status is emitted

quality_scenarios.stimulus: adds a server inbox persistence implementation
quality_scenarios.response: concrete persistence is changed/wired without moving domain policy into UI
quality_scenarios.response_measure: binary pass: domain/application architecture tests still pass and repository port remains the application dependency

quality_scenarios.response: no server/service secret is required by the browser persistence path
quality_scenarios.response_measure: binary pass: no secret-valued environment variable or service-role credential is present in tracked frontend files

assumptions.statement: A Node-capable web deployment remains acceptable for the near-term web MVP.
assumptions.review_trigger: Hosting constraint or MCL-1 decision contradicts a Node server deployment.

missing_information.review_trigger: MCL-1 transitions to a decided state.

missing_information.statement: No MCL-specific Confluence page was located through connected searches in this run.
missing_information.review_trigger: Canonical MCL Confluence page is identified.

missing_information.statement: Production hosting, authentication mechanism, retention and recovery objectives are not yet fixed in the read backlog.
